Writer} \maketitle egin{abstract} We study small things. \end{abstract}` | | 14.2 | Title block with affiliations and keywords | Write a paper's title block with two authors, each with a university affiliation, and a list of keywords. | `\author[1]{Ann Lee} \author[2]{Bo Chen} \affil[1]{University of Oxford} \affil[2]{Stanford University} \keywords{graphs, coloring, bounds}` | | 14.3 | Theorem and proof | Write a short mathematical passage with a numbered theorem followed by its proof, ending with an end-of-proof mark. | ` egin{theorem} There are infinitely many primes. \end{theorem} egin{proof} Consider $p_1 \cdots p_n + 1$. \end{proof}` | | 14.4 | Numbered definition | Write a numbered definition of a prime number, set apart from the surrounding text the way math books do. | ` egin{definition} A \emph{prime} is an integer $p > 1$ whose only positive divisors are $1$ and $p$. \end{definition}` | | 14.5 | Epigraph | Write the opening of a chapter with a short epigraph quotation and its attribution, set apart before the first paragraph. | `\chapter{Beginnings} \epigraph{All happy families are alike.}{Leo Tolstoy} The story starts here.` | | 14.6 | Pull quote | Write a paragraph of an article and a pull quote that repeats a striking line from it in larger type. | `The town never recovered. Nobody forgets a flood. egin{pullquote} Nobody forgets a flood. \end{pullquote}` | | 14.7 | Framed box | Write a paragraph followed by a short piece of text inside a framed box. | `Here is the main text. box{\parbox{0.8\linewidth}{Remember to save often.}}` | | 14.8 | Algorithm in pseudocode | Write a short algorithm in numbered pseudocode with the caption 'Binary search'. | ` egin{algorithm}\caption{Binary search} egin{algorithmic}[1] \While{$lo \le hi$} \State $mid \gets \lfloor (lo+hi)/2 floor$ \If{$A[mid] = x$} \Return $mid$ \EndIf \EndWhile \end{algorithmic}\end{algorithm}` | | 14.9 | Subfigures | Write a passage with two images shown side by side, each with its own sub-caption (a) and (b), and one overall caption. | ` egin{figure} \subfloat[Before]{\includegraphics[width=.45\linewidth]{a.png}}\hfill \subfloat[After]{\includegraphics[width=.45\linewidth]{b.png}} \caption{Comparison.} \end{figure}` | | 14.10 | Reference to a page number | Write a sentence that refers to the page number where the section called Results begins, so the number updates automatically. | `\section{Results}\label{sec:results} ... See the results on page~\pageref{sec:results}.` | | 14.11 | List of figures | Write a short document outline that includes an automatically generated list of figures. | ` ableofcontents \listoffigures \section{Introduction} \section{Methods}` | | 14.12 | Appendix | Write a short document with two main sections followed by an appendix labeled with a letter. | `\section{Introduction} \section{Results} \appendix \section{Proofs}` | | 14.13 | Acronyms spelled out on first use | Write two sentences that use the acronym API, so that its first use is spelled out automatically and it appears in a generated list of acronyms. | ` ewacronym{api}{API}{application programming interface} We expose an \gls{api}. The \gls{api} is stable. \printglossary[type=\acronymtype]` | | 14.14 | Units and quantities | Write a sentence giving a speed of 3.5 × 10^8 meters per second and a temperature of 21 degrees Celsius, with the units typeset correctly. | `It moved at \qty{3.5e8}{\metre\per\second} in a room at \qty{21}{\degreeCelsius}.` | | 14.15 | Chemical equation | Write the balanced chemical equation for burning methane, typeset as chemistry. | `\ce{CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O}` | | 14.16 | Margin to-do note | Write a paragraph with an editorial to-do note attached to it, shown in the margin. | `The sample size was large. odo{Add exact sample size.}` | | 14.17 | Line numbers for review | Write a short paragraph set up so that the printed version shows line numbers in the margin for reviewers. | `\usepackage{lineno} \linenumbers This paragraph will show line numbers in the margin.` | | 14.18 | Drop cap | Write the first paragraph of a story with its first letter set as a large drop cap. | `\lettrine{O}{nce} upon a time, there lived a fox.` | | 14.19 | Hyphenation hints | Write a sentence containing the word electroencephalography, marking the places where it may be hyphenated. | `The patient had an elec\-tro\-en\-ceph\-a\-log\-ra\-phy scan.` | | 14.20 | Numbered paragraphs | Write three paragraphs of a contract that are numbered 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 automatically. | `\section{Terms} egin{enumerate}[label= hesection.\arabic*] \item The Seller agrees to deliver. \item The Buyer agrees to pay. \item Both parties agree to the terms. \end{enumerate}` | | 14.21 | Colored text | Write a sentence where the word 'blocked' is shown in red text. | `The request was extcolor{red}{blocked} by the firewall.` | | 14.22 | Subtext line | Write a heading followed by a line of small, muted subtext under it. | `## Release Notes Updated October 2026` | | 14.23 | Inline badge | Write a sentence ending with a small colored badge that reads 'beta'. | `Try the new editor beta` | | 14.24 | Inline data fields | Write a note about a book that includes a rating of 5 and a genre of mystery as data fields a query tool could read. | `# The Hound of the Baskervilles rating:: 5 genre:: mystery A gripping read.` | | 14.25 | Key-value list | Write a short list of facts about a person (name, year born, occupation) that should display as aligned key-value pairs. | `Name : Ada Lovelace Born : 1815 Occupation : Mathematician` | | 14.26 | Side-brace grouping | Write three related lines grouped together by a large curly brace with a label beside it. | `$\left. egin{array}{l} ext{Apples}\ ext{Pears}\ ext{Plums}\end{array} ight\}\ ext{Fruit}$` | | 14.27 | Table formula | Write a small table of expenses whose total row is computed by a formula. | `\| Item \| Cost \| \|---\|---\| \| Rent \| 1200 \| \| Food \| 400 \| \| Total \| =SUM(B2:B3) \|` | | 14.28 | Callout on one list item | Write a bulleted list where one item is highlighted as a warning by a marker at the start of that item. | `- Back up your data - ⚠️ **Warning:** Do not unplug during update - Restart when done` | | 14.29 | Note template | Write a daily-note template that inserts today's date and the note's title automatically when a note is created. | `# {{title}} Date: {{date:YYYY-MM-DD}} ## Tasks - ` | | 14.30 | Inline icon | Write a sentence with a small heart icon from an icon set shown inline. | `Made with aHeart\ by the team.` |
